# Contributing to StoryForge

## Run locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/VedantSB207/storyforge.git
cd storyforge
npm install
npm run dev:electron
```

Requires Node.js 18+ and an Anthropic API key (entered on first launch).

## Report bugs

Use the [Bug Report](https://github.com/VedantSB207/storyforge/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) issue template. Include steps to reproduce, your OS, and any console errors.

## Submit changes

1. Fork the repo
2. Create a branch (`feat/your-feature` or `fix/your-fix`)
3. Make your changes and test in Electron mode
4. Open a PR against `main`

See the full [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) in the repo root for branch naming, commit conventions, and code style notes.

## Propose features

Open a [Discussion](https://github.com/VedantSB207/storyforge/discussions) before writing code so we can align on approach.
